PlanItemStatus.description:
Status of a milestone, an epic, a user story or a task (SPEC-0001 R5); `draft` is the initial status. `blocked` is never one: it is a state of the issue cycle (SPEC-0002).

- `draft`: Proposed, not approved.
- `approved`: Approved by a person; work may start.
- `implementing`: Work has started: the item, or a task of it, is claimed.
- `done`: Delivered; terminal.
- `superseded`: Replaced by the items in `superseded_by`; terminal.

SpecReference.description: A reference of a task to a living specification and to requirements of it.

requirements.description: Requirements of that specification the task implements; `[]` means that the task cites the specification without a particular requirement.

items.description: Identifier of a requirement of a living specification: `R` and a number from 1 without a leading zero, for example `R2`.

Verification.description:
A verification technique of a task or of an acceptance criterion (SPEC-0009 R7).

- `tdd`: Test-driven development: a test written before the code.
- `bdd`: Behaviour-driven development: a scenario in the language of the user.
- `end_to_end`: A test of the whole system, through its interface.
- `property`: A property test over generated inputs.
- `contract`: A contract test against a published schema or case.
- `benchmark`: A measurement against a stated threshold.
- `judge`: A judgement against a rubric, which is then required (SPEC-0009 R8).
- `none`: Verified by no technique, stated on purpose.

description: A task of an epic (SPEC-0001, Task), a tracker sub-issue of its epic closed by one pull request.

area.description: Area of the project policy, without the `area:` prefix; decides what can run in parallel.

items.description: Identifier of a task: `TASK-` and four digits, or five or more without a leading zero, for example `TASK-0107`.

expanded_from.description: Task this subtask was expanded from; that task is superseded by this one.

id.description: Stable identifier, in the canonical form of the type; assigned by the engine and never reused (SPEC-0001 R2, R14).

issue.description: Tracker number of the issue, cited by branches and pull requests; required when `status` is `implementing` or `done`.

language.description: Language of the prose, a BCP 47 tag; when absent, the language of the project.

milestone.description: Milestone of the task; must equal the milestone of its epic.

parallel.description: Whether the task can run in parallel with other tasks of the epic.

rubric.description: Rubric of the judge; required when `verification` contains `judge`.

schema_version.description: Version of the schema of the type the document was written against (SPEC-0001 R16).

specification.description: Specifications and requirements the task implements; `[]` means none.

status.description: Current status (SPEC-0001 R5), not the issue-cycle state of SPEC-0002.

story.description: Story the task serves; its epic must be `epic`.

superseded_by.description: Identifiers of the artifacts of the same type that replace this one, at least one; required when `status` is `superseded`.

items.description: Identifier of a task: `TASK-` and four digits, or five or more without a leading zero, for example `TASK-0107`.

title.description: Outcome or name, in sentence case without a final full stop; 1 to 120 characters (Unicode code points).

verification.description: Verification techniques; at least one. The order of the values and a value repeated carry no meaning.

title: Task
